entities.summary: Taghreed Hikmat is a Jordanian judge. In 1996 she became Jordan's first female judge. She was a judge on the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda from 2003 to 2011. Later, she served in the Senate of Jordan from 2013 until 2020. Since October 2020 she has been a judge on the Constitutional Court of Jordan.
